verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs explicitly describe CDC support: reading binlog/WAL change logs while tracking log position to capture INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE without heavy querying of the source, which directly matches the story. This is backed by dedicated CDC documentation and reinforced by incremental sync mode docs. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of CDC reliability at scale (one community note describes needing manual workarounds for a very large 8B-row table, suggesting some real-world friction) and no per-connector CDC coverage/performance benchmarks are cited.
